summary: PM-1-RX lane-G implementation: the three end-to-end tests in harness/tests/test_runner.py failed with json.decoder.JSONDecodeError raised inside pm1rx/codecs.py (_parse_json_payload) when the bare DeterministicReferenceBackend() returned its documented '[deterministic-fallback:...]' marker for the structured-checkpoint prompt tag (arms C/E/F).
root_cause: codecs.py violated the v1.2 decoding-failure contract (oracle.md §5, revision 002 G11): an unparseable model response must be carried in the representation as raw content (content_format application/json) so the oracle can attribute 'decoding_failure'; instead _parse_json_payload raised JSONDecodeError and crashed the episode. The backend (DeterministicReferenceBackend) was used within its documented contract (generate -> {text, usage}; fallback marker for unknown keys), so the backend was not at fault. Fixed at the codec boundary: _parse_json_payload_or_raw() carries raw text on parse failure; _payload_fields() guards fields_present; regression test added in tests/test_codecs.py (test_unparseable_model_output_is_carried_not_crashed).

fix.note: Behavior changes only for unparseable model output (previously crash; now decoding_failure attribution per G11). Valid-JSON output path unchanged.

remaining_blockers.root_cause: NO_REPRESENTATION is not in the v1.2 representation.schema.json enum (documented spec gap; pinned by test_codecs.py::test_no_representation_type_not_in_schema_enum). store.put('representation', ...) fails closed.

runner.truncate_to_budget returns truncation_method='none' arms (A_full_transcript) unchanged, so the matched-budget artifact exceeds the budget (853 > 18); the test asserts truncated size <= budget for every arm. Harness README documents the runner's behavior.
